symptom: A filemanager outside any data container, or in a data view on an entity that does not extend System.FileDocument, passed `mxcli check` and `exec` and failed `mx check` with CE6810 "A file manager must be placed in a data view or snippet that is connected to entity 'System.FileDocument' or a specialization" (mendixlabs/mxcli#151).
cause: Nothing checked the widget's context: a file manager binds no attribute, so the input-binding checks (MDL-WIDGET34, checkInputBinding) never looked at it.
file: mdl/executor/validate_page_context.go (fileManagersWithoutContext, reported as MDL-WIDGET34 from validate_widgets.go — no project needed); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (buildFileManagerV3 refuses a context entity via pageBuilder.provablyNotSpecializationOf)
insight: A refusal built on the generalization chain must separate 'extends nothing' from 'not loaded': generalizationOf returns "" for both, and the System module (System.Image, itself a FileDocument) is never among the loaded domain models, so refusing on "" would have rejected valid pages. Measure before encoding a rule: mx accepts a file manager at the top of a snippet with a FileDocument parameter, and a parameterless snippet takes its object from the data view it is placed in — a draft rule refusing that was dropped unmeasured. Wiring the new rule into validateWithContext alone did nothing for plain `check`, which reports through ValidateWidgetPropertiesForStatement.
